items.docs: This endpoint extends the original `make_payment` API endpoint to allow asynchronous processing. Clients may optionally supply a wait parameter to have the server wait up to 30 seconds for a response from internal business systems. If a response has been received in that time, it is returned immediately. Otherwise status information and links are returned.
